icons.glyphDescription: Short open curved back arrow: undo one move
Existing clockwise restart arrow, empty centre

icons.semantics: One reduce-motion icon: on tint #E9BC65FF; off tint #EEE7D0FF. No second sprite.

icons.notes: Source is 250x30 logical. Render height is text preferred height + 16; width 250 to 320, per shared contract.

importPolicy.webgl: RGBA32, no block compression, no crunch
importPolicy.pixelsPerUnit: 100 times source scale; SetNativeSize is logical size with referencePixelsPerUnit 100
